correctness.rationale: The transfer-matrix Cayley–Hamilton recurrence gives strict negative-root interlacing. On the conjugate-eigenvalue band the exact phase increases from zero to pi, giving interval root counts n Delta(theta)/pi + O(1); normalized density follows by differentiation and mass one. Independent exact rational enumeration and numerical root checks corroborate the formulas without replacing the infinite proof.
